findings.title: walking within the earth-domain

findings.mechanism: The carrier is locative fi; the independent trigger is definite al-ard as its governed genitive complement. Their relation frames walking inside a containing place rather than making earth the movement's object.
findings.reader_payoff: The command first locates the body in a shared terrain and then marks how it moves there.
findings.containment: The phrase is a local locative; no alternate preposition or outside walking scene is supplied.

epistemic.reason: The preposition, genitive noun, and attachment to walking are explicit.

findings.title: earth-walking and earth-mountain fields
findings.claim: Within this focus, the excessive gait occurs inside earth and is answered by denied breach below and denied reach above, linking outward conduct to bodily scale.
findings.mechanism: The carriers are walking with maraḥan and the locative earth; the independent triggers are the later direct-object earth and mountain-height clause. The relation turns the local act of walking into the behavior tested by the terrain proof; cited comparisons at 17:4 and 17:95 are excluded.
findings.reader_payoff: The conduct field and terrain scale explain one another within the ayah instead of relying on a surah-wide argument.
findings.containment: Only the focus-local relation survives; no 17:4 or 17:95 reading is asserted.

epistemic.reason: The local focus words support the synthesis; the same-surah/corpus links were not supplied as context surfaces.

findings.title: known earth as walking-domain
findings.claim: The article on al-ard presents the known earth as the domain of the walk rather than a private patch of ground.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is definite al-ard in the genitive; the independent trigger is fi governing it as the location of tamshi. Definite reference plus locative attachment makes the scene the known earth as a whole.
findings.reader_payoff: The command's setting is broad and shared, not a small piece of ground selected by the walker.
findings.containment: The definite form supports known earth; it does not assert a cosmological totality beyond the ordinary noun.

epistemic.reason: Article, genitive case, and preposition are independently supplied.

findings.title: earth as broad lower containing field
findings.claim: The known earth is the lower inhabited field inside which the walker is measured against mountain height.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is al-ard as locative ground; the independent trigger is the mountain plural with tulan specifying an upward measure. Their contact makes the earth the lower spatial datum rather than an unspecified surface.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees the walk bounded by the broad ground beneath it and the mountain scale above.
findings.containment: The physical earth remains the local meaning; the lower-datum relation is a focus-local extension.

epistemic.reason: The earth branch is supplied; its lower-field reading is activated by the independent mountain-height clause.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yer ve yere bakan alt bölüm
branch_activations.facet_statement: Göğün karşısında aşağıda bulunan ve üzerinde yaşanan yer küresidir.
branch_activations.carrier: Al-ard carries the ordinary inhabited earth below.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The mountain target and explicit height measure create an independent upper comparator.
branch_activations.activation: The lower-ground facet meets mountain height, setting a focus-local lower datum.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Earth reads as the broad lower field of the terrain proof.
branch_activations.boundary: No other branch facet, such as an object's underside, is activated.

findings.title: same earth shifts role later
findings.claim: The first earth occurrence prepares the reader for the same definite noun to return as the object of the impossible breach.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is al-ard after fi; the independent trigger is its repeated form in accusative position after takhriqa. The noun's identity persists as its case and syntactic role change, so the later test is already latent in the opening location.
findings.reader_payoff: The terrain that contains the walker is also what the second clause tests.
findings.containment: This is a repeated-word and case relation; no separate object sense is substituted for earth.

epistemic.reason: The focus repeats the definite noun with supplied genitive and accusative attachments.

findings.title: hard texture of the repeated earth word
findings.claim: The repeated earth form can lend the return of the ground a hard phonetic edge as it becomes the object of an impossible breach.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the same al-ard sound in both focus positions; the independent trigger is the later takhriqa-object relation and its explicit denial. Their contact lets the repeated texture accompany the shift from setting to resistant target.
findings.reader_payoff: Sound and syntax reinforce the sense of one material ground returning under pressure.
findings.containment: The packet supplies a local sound observation, but sound alone does not prove hardness or a universal sound-symbolic rule.

epistemic.reason: The repetition and sound note are supplied; their association with resistance remains a bounded auditory inference.

findings.title: accusative manner or intensifier
findings.claim: Maraḥan can attach as state, purpose, or intensifying accusative; each supplied analysis keeps the walking marked by exultant excess.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the indefinite maṣdar maraḥan; the independent trigger is tamshi, whose manner or purpose it supplies, together with the prohibition on that manner. The grammatical alternatives meet on the quality of the gait without settling one attachment as exclusive.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader understands why the ban targets how the person walks while the exact accusative relation remains open.
findings.containment: State, purpose, and intensification coexist as supported analyses; the word still modifies the walking scene rather than defining a permanent identity.

epistemic.reason: The bundle preserves multiple syntactic possibilities and converges on excessive manner without adjudicating among them.

findings.title: quality attached to walking, variant characterizes person
findings.claim: The supplied surface makes maraḥan a quality of the walk, while the attributed variant would move that quality onto the walker.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the received maṣdar attached to the walking phrase; the independent trigger is the supplied variant characterization of the person. Their contrast changes the grammatical bearer of the exultance while leaving the physical walking scene recognizable.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can keep both the manner-focused surface and the person-focused counter-reading in view.
findings.containment: The received focus surface remains intact; the variant is attributed and is not used to replace or rank it.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies a trusted summary of the variant contrast but not the variant surface itself.

findings.title: joy turned into wanton display
findings.claim: The root's intense, restless joy meets the prohibited walking manner, so the gait carries exultance that has become insolent display.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is maraḥan; the independent triggers are bodily tamshi and prohibitive la. The excessive-joy facet contacts a mannered, forbidden gait, changing neutral happiness into a visibly overfull performance in this clause.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader senses animation and overflow inside the arrogance, rather than reducing the word to a flat moral label.
findings.containment: The root supports excess and liveliness; insolence comes from their local contact with the prohibition and gait, not from a claim that all joy is blameworthy.

epistemic.reason: The branch supports excessive joy; the moral coloring is supplied by the local manner and prohibition.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: ölçüyü aşan, yerinde durdurmayan sevinç ve canlılık
branch_activations.facet_statement: Sevinç çok güçlüdür, olağan ölçüyü aşar ve kişiyi yerinde duramayacak kadar taşkınlaştırır.
branch_activations.carrier: Maraḥan carries intense joy that exceeds its measure.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The walking verb and its prohibitive governor make the manner bodily and prohibited.
branch_activations.activation: Excessive joy contacts the gait being restrained, coloring it as restless display.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The walker appears animated by overfull, insolent exultance.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not make ordinary joy itself culpable.

findings.title: emphatic frame over both impossibilities
findings.claim: Inna-ka pivots from the walking command to an emphatic, personal rationale containing both impossibility clauses.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is inna with its second-person suffix; the independent trigger is the two coordinated lan predicates that follow. Their attachment makes the breach and reach denials the reason addressed to the same person.
findings.reader_payoff: The physical limits read as the stated ground of the prohibition, not as a detached afterthought.
findings.containment: The rationale covers both clauses and does not select one as the ayah's sole explanation.

epistemic.reason: The emphatic particle, suffix, and clause attachment are supplied in the focus.

findings.title: singular addressee under emphasis
findings.claim: The emphatic suffix and repeated second-person verbs keep one addressee in view from the command through both proofs.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the ka suffix on inna; the independent triggers are the second-person tamshi, takhriqa, and tablugha forms. Their repeated person marking gathers the whole sequence around one directly addressed body.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader experiences a continuous personal correction rather than an abstract statement about people in general.
findings.containment: Singular grammar does not exclude application beyond the addressed person.

epistemic.reason: The suffix and all three second-person verb forms are supplied.

findings.title: lower and upper impossibility bracket
findings.claim: The repeated lan frames two live impossibilities, one directed down through earth and the other up toward mountain height.
findings.mechanism: The lan particles are the carriers; their independent triggers are takhriqa with earth and tablugha with mountains/tulan. Repeated negation joins unlike directions into a paired spatial proof.
findings.reader_payoff: The first denial becomes one half of a bracket whose upper half is separately stated.
findings.containment: The clauses remain distinct in action and object even while their negation is parallel.

epistemic.reason: Both particles and both governed predicates are explicitly present.

findings.title: first future impossibility marker
findings.claim: The first lan turns earth-piercing into a denied future capacity, moving the ayah from restraint into proof.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is the first lan; the independent trigger is subjunctive takhriqa with al-ard as its direct object. Their relation makes the breach an imagined future act explicitly unavailable to the addressee.
findings.reader_payoff: The lower limit is presented as a capacity the addressed person cannot achieve.
findings.containment: The future denial supports the impossibility reading while the opening prohibition remains the primary act.

epistemic.reason: The particle's governance and the verb-object frame are supplied.

findings.title: physical piercing with boundary-breaking pressure
findings.claim: Physical piercing stays the direct sense, while the root's measureless-action branch meets the preceding excess and lets the breach image echo boundary-transgression.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is Form I takhriqa with earth as its direct object; the independent trigger is the earlier maraḥan manner of excess. Their cross-root contact turns a physical breach into a bounded echo of rashly crossing measure, while lan denies the act.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can feel why an arrogant gait is answered with an image of impossible physical overreach.
findings.containment: The verb remains physical piercing; the measureless-action branch is a qualified resonance and does not become a replacement gloss.

epistemic.reason: The surface and object select physical breach; the measureless branch is a focus-local cross-root inference.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi gereken ölçüyü kuramaz, işi bilmez veya onu iyi yapamaz.
branch_activations.carrier: Takhriqa carries physical breach in Form I, with a possible root pressure of unmeasured action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: Maraḥan supplies excessive manner, while the earth object fixes the physical target.
branch_activations.activation: The measureless-action facet meets the earlier excess through the same addressed act, adding a rough overreach echo.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The denied physical breach can also register as rash boundary-crossing.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch is not substituted for the locally selected physical piercing sense.

findings.title: rare future breach as lower axis
findings.claim: The future breach projects a downward act that is immediately blocked and paired with the later upward reach toward mountains.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is takhriqa under lan; the independent trigger is tablugha al-jibal tulan in the coordinated second clause. Their opposing directions turn the denied breach into the lower axis of one focus-local proof.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader hears a spatially complete test rather than an isolated image of force.
findings.containment: The rare-form observation is evidence about this verb's form, not a new lexical meaning or external comparison.

epistemic.reason: The two directions and their clauses are explicit in the focus; the form note is locally supplied.

findings.title: basic Form I breach denied
findings.claim: The future denial reaches even the basic Form I act of breaching the earth.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is Form I takhriqa; the independent triggers are lan's future denial and the definite earth object. Their contact denies the elementary physical act itself, rather than a derived intensification.
findings.reader_payoff: The limit is complete at the level of the basic action.
findings.containment: No derived stem is present, and the focus does not compare this act with an outside scene.

epistemic.reason: QAC supplies the Form I verb, its governor, and its direct object.

findings.title: subjunctive transitive breach under denial
findings.claim: Lan governs a subjunctive transitive breach verb whose explicit patient is the definite earth.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is takhriqa; the independent triggers are lan and al-ard in direct-object position. Their attachment makes the denied act concrete: the ground is grammatically targetable even as the future act is ruled out.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a physical target and a precise impossibility rather than a vague claim of weakness.
findings.containment: The object relation does not imply that any breach occurs.

epistemic.reason: The QAC morphology and supplied attachment agree on governor, mood, verb, and object.

findings.title: b01_scale_disproportion
findings.claim: The plain ban on arrogant walking opens into a bodily scale test: gait claims magnitude, while earth below and mountain height above expose the claim as disproportionate.
findings.mechanism: Before, the focus is a prohibition of an arrogant walking style; after, voluntary gait colored by excessive elation performs a claim tested in two directions. The carriers are the focus roots for walking, earth, marah, breach, reaching, mountains, and height; the independent triggers are their separate words and clause relations. Their contact makes the two denied acts measure the walker's bodily scale.
findings.reader_payoff: Swagger is newly visible as a performed claim of force below and stature above, with the physical earth and mountains setting the limits.
findings.containment: This remains a focus-local scale image: it does not say walking literally means pride, claim a theological doctrine, or displace the ordinary prohibition. The sky-facing aspect belongs to the earth branch gloss; the actual local upper trigger is the mountain clause.

epistemic.reason: The composite mechanism is focus-grounded and all coordinates match supplied QAC, but its HFT author is legacy_unbound.

findings.title: b02_failed_sovereign_passage
findings.claim: The plain prohibition of proud gait also resembles a claim to free passage and superior reach; earth and mountain limit that imagined agency.
findings.mechanism: Before, the walker displays excessive pride; after, intentional locomotion meets the earth-traversal branch of takhriqa and the mountain's hard obstruction, while the height word meets the preceding arrogance. The contact makes the gait a small performance of unrestricted mastery that the paired terrain tests bound.
findings.reader_payoff: The failure clauses answer the swagger as a claim to move or rise without limit, not only as a feeling.
findings.containment: Passage sovereignty is an analogy. The noun earth does not itself mean heaviness, the mountain clause does not describe excavation, and the social superiority branch is not a direct gloss for tulan.

epistemic.reason: The five focus coordinates are verified by supplied QAC, but the agency synthesis comes from a legacy_unbound HFT trace and several form-restricted branches.

findings.title: o02_transient_growth_against_geologic_scale
findings.claim: The ordinary prohibition remains a ban on proud gait; as an exploratory analogy, the focus can also resemble a fast growth flush mistaking a surge for lasting stature.
findings.mechanism: Before, marah is a human burst of proud joy checked by physical size; after, the focus's growth and vegetation branches meet fertile-ground, mountain-mass, and duration branches. The walking/growth carrier and marah's quick greening meet earth as substrate, while mountain and temporal tulan make a rapid surge answer to durable scale.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can glimpse a transient increase set against geological mass and duration, a distinct image that remains alongside the human gait reading.
findings.containment: This is an analogical, form-distant image, not a report of rain, crops, or literal vegetation in the verse. The earth noun stays the known ground, marah remains the local manner word, and tulan remains height in direct grammar.

epistemic.reason: The traced roots and exact QAC carriers agree, but the ecological synthesis is legacy_unbound and explicitly form-distant.
